correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the labeled row-subset ensemble and Z=Σ_j(-1)^j C(n,j)∏_i C(n−j,r_i), positive when Σ r_i≥n. A marked column shared by rows i,k gives n H_ik; a two-marked-column polynomial with factors C(n−2−j,r_i)+C(n−2−j,r_i−1)(u+v)+C(n−2−j,r_i−2)uvw counts both degrees and overlap. Restrict a,b≥1 and a≠b, divide c by min(a,b), add normalized row terms and divide by K Z. Ties correctly contribute zero. The O(m^3) coefficient states updated over m factors and n exclusions justify O(nm^4) exact arithmetic, not bit time. An independent 3×4 (1,2,3) full enumeration gives 60 covered matrices and mean 7/15. The finite checker is only corroboration; inclusion-exclusion is the all-parameter proof.
